method.policy: Public operations only; same seed and recipe in each pair, at most two aging casks (capacity remains four), bottle at six months to the same repeat brand and standard retail price. Both arms share production requests and only start when both can safely fund the same cask. First fill manual; subsequent one-shot usual reservations explicitly renewed per request. Existing trade offers declined equally. No-shop declines passive shop offers; shop accepts and explicitly delivers up to 10 bottles per brand per month. One monthly demand pool is retained; deliveries never become retail reputation. No new production starts after 120 months; any already-running extraction finishes on its original clock, and the fixed remaining cohort is separately liquidated.
method.limits: A specified repeat-brand player policy, not an optimization or human preference verdict. Counterfactual retailer customer demand is abstract buyout, not a simulated second sales shelf. No-shop is not forced to accept or deliver. Terminal liquidation distinguishes discounted lifetime receipts from inventory timing. Physical Safari and subjective interest are outside this simulation.
